New Starters Letters
New Starters from September 2025
Welcome to Our School!
We are delighted to welcome all new pupils and their families to our school community. Starting a new school is an exciting time, and we are here to support you every step of the way.
If you would like more information about our school or wish to arrange a tour or meeting, a member of our Senior Leadership Team would be happy to show you around and answer any questions you may have.
Once you are on roll with us we will send out our New Starters Handbook and all relevent information to ensure that your new begining with us is as smooth as possible.
For pupils starting in Year 3 each September we will contact you directly with the transition information, parent meetings and school events.
If you are new to the area and have applied for a school place mid-year please be assured that you will be provided with all the information you need prior to starting with us and our team are happy to answer all questions or arrange a "taster day" if required.
Please contact the school office if you would like to book an appointment — we look forward to meeting you!

pageCache.text:
Interim Headteachers Welcome
Welcome to Sun Hill Junior School
It is with great pleasure that we welcome you to Sun Hill Junior School and are delighted that you and your child are part of our school community. At Sun Hill Junior School, we believe that every child is unique and deserves to feel valued, included and respected. We are proud of the warm, welcoming environment we create, where children feel safe, secure and confident to be themselves.
Our commitment extends beyond academic achievement. We strive to nurture the whole child by supporting their wellbeing, celebrating their interests and talents, and providing a rich curriculum alongside a wide range of experiences. Through these experiences, we encourage children to develop confidence, resilience and initiative, while growing in their understanding of themselves and others.
We are ambitious for all our pupils and determined to provide the very best environment for them to succeed. Our dedicated and enthusiastic staff work tirelessly to help every child achieve their potential, preparing them not only for their next steps in education, but also for the wider world beyond school. We want every child to have a sense of purpose, know that their voice matters, and develop the skills and qualities needed to thrive in the future.
Thank you for the trust and support you place in us. A strong partnership between home and school is at the heart of everything we do, and by working together we can help every child flourish. We look forward to working with you throughout the year and wish all our families a happy, successful and rewarding 2026–2027 academic year.
Marie-Louise WoodsInterim Head Teacher

Wellbeing at Sun Hill Juniors
We keep the wellbeing of all our children, staff and community at the heart of school life at Sun Hill Junior School. At SHJS we explore and promote the '6 signs of wellbeing': active, responsible, connected, resilient, respected, aware. This program of wellbeing was developed during 2019-2020 and has continued to be a regular part of school life. We also promote the importance of mindfulness, with activities and practises to help achieve mindfulness.
Our Wellbeing program is continually under review as we aim to respond to the everchanging priorities and needs of our school community.

pageCache.text:
Clubs
With the support of our sports premium allocation Sun Hill Junior School is delighted to offer after-school sports clubs at a reduced cost. These clubs are run by the school using external coaches who work closely with us to provide the best after-school sporting opportunities for our pupils.
Each term we open the club registration applications with a strict completion date. Each club is open to all pupils to ensure that these clubs and the sports funding allocated to the school is accessible to all.
If your child would like to participate in any of our school after-school sports clubs please contact the school office.
Places will be awarded at random, but numbers are limited and places in each club will fill-up fast. Enrolment via the form is required every term to ensure a fair opportunity for a place.
Once a childs place has been confirmed on an after-school sports club payment for the term is required in full. If payment is not made by the requested date, the place will be offered to another child.
Should the club be cancelled due to “unforeseen circumstances” you will either receive a refund or credit to your childs scopay account at your request. However, if your child decides not to participate in the club, no refund will be issued.
Please note, this is a school run club and therefore the school's behaviour policy (link) still applies. Parents will be informed of any inappropriate behaviour and your child may lose their clubs privileges if there is a consistent issue. In this circumstance no refund will apply.
Children MUST wear the appropriate clothing and should come to school in their school PE kit on the day of their club. For football, socks, shin pads and football boots are required. All outside sports need layers and gloves for the colder months. If a child does not have the appropriate kit, they will be unable to take part.
We have a number of paid clubs supplied by external providers held at either Sun Hill Junior School or Sun Hill Infant School.
Dance club with Intergr8 dance (3:30pm-4:30pm)
Football with Soccer School UK (3.30pm-4.30pm)
Sunshine Singers
Sunshine Singers is a singing club which takes place at Sun Hill Infant School. We would love to invite anyone who loves singing to join us for a really fun time. We meet on a Wednesday from 3.30 to 4.25pm and collect pupils from Sun Hill Junior School to join us at the infant school. The charge is £2 a week or £1.50 each if more than one child. Contact Rosie Waring Green on [email protected] or 07891120662 for further details.
Cook Stars Juniors – Wednesday 3.45pm-5pm
At Sun Hill Infant School
Our classes are very hands-on with everyone making their own dish from scratch!
Every week we make something different with inspiration taken from dishes around the world. With such a variety of dishes we try plenty of different preparation techniques....from icing to dicing we do it all! https://www.cookstars.co.uk/cooking-classes/mid-hants
La Colline du Soleil French club – Thursday 3.45pm-4.45pm
At Sun Hill Junior School
Join me each Thursday for French club where we play games, learn songs, make music and do arts and crafts. Beaucoup de plaisir !
For more information and to book a place please contact Marion at [email protected]

Wraparound Care - Sunrise and Sunset Club
Sun Hill Junior School provides breakfast and after-school provision for Sun Hill Infant and Sun Hill Junior pupils, five days per week from Year R to Year 6. Both Breakfast Club and After School Clubs are operated by our school staff and we are pround to provide high-quality out-of-school childcare for our parents/carers.
​Staff provide a range of stimulating and creative activities in a safe trusted environment following all school safeguarding and behaviour procedures.
Sunrise Breakfast Club (7:30-8:45 am)
Breakfast Club is run in-house by our Breakfast Club Team and opens daily from 7:30-8:45 am. The children are provided with a variety of breakfast options (nut-free) from 7:30-8:15 am and activities in the school hall until 8:45 am, Junior pupils are then directed to their classrooms and Infants pupils are accompanied to Sun Hill Infant School and passed directly to a member of Infant school staff.
Sessions for Breakfast Club must be booked and paid for via our online payment system 'ScoPay'. Childcare vouchers are accepted - please select Sun Hill Junior School as your provider. Each session costs £7.00 per child and the club is open to all children attending Sun Hill Junior and Sun Hill Infant school full-time providing they are happy to be left.
​Parents must sign their child in on the Breakfast Club register each day they attend. ​
Sunset After-School Club (3:25-6:00 pm)
After-School Club is run in-house by our After-School Club Team and opens daily until 6 pm. It is open to all children attending Sun Hill Junior and Sun Hill Infant School full-time providing they are happy to be left.
​Sun Hill Infant School children are collected from their school and registered at the end of the school day and taken to the Sun Hill Junior School Hall. Junior School pupils will be directed to the School Hall by their class teacher. A light tea is offered after some time to play and wind down with friends.
​Sessions for After-School Club must be booked and paid for in advance via our online payment system 'ScoPay'. Childcare vouchers and Government tax-free childcare schemes are accepted. Each session currently costs £14.50 per child and all children must be collected by 6 pm (late collection fees apply).
​Parents must collect by the allotted time and each child must be signed out on the register.
​Sessions must be booked through the Calendar option on the App (or web). The booking system will automatically close 5 days prior to any session.
We also offer an Emergency 30-Minute Care option at our Afterschool Club for those times when you just need a little extra time at the end of the school day.
· Emergency Care (up to 30 minutes): £5
· Please note: Any collection after 4:00 PM will be charged the full late session fee of £19.50.
You can book this as you would any other session (within the usual 5 days pre-booking required) or as an emgergency by contacting the extended day team on 01962 732801 or email: [email protected]
We hope this added flexibility helps make your afternoons a little easier.
For further information please email [email protected] Please note that a waiting list may operate at any point throughout the year so please check well in advance if you wish to book.
For further information see our
Wraparound extended day Handbook.
​If you need to contact wraparound care in an emergency from 7.30am-8.45am or 3.30pm-6pm please call them directly on 01962 671336
​Outside of these hours all calls regarding extended day should come via the school office: 01962 732801

Careers at Sun Hill Junior School
Vita Multi Academy Trust is committed to safeguarding children and promoting the welfare of children, young people and adults. We expect all employees, workers and volunteers to share this commitment. All our recruitment and selection practices reflect this commitment.
For roles working with children and children’s data, we comply with the “Safer Recruitment” national guidelines. Ideally, we will take up references before the interview for these roles; however, we do understand that with some positions this is not always possible. We will always be discrete, and if the role that you are applying for allows, you will have the option to let us know if you do not want us to contact your current employer.
​For details on our current vacancies and more information on the application process, please visit The Vita Multi Academy Trust website.

Whether you're a prospective parent or simply curious about what makes our school special, we invite you to explore and discover what makes our community so unique.

Vita Multi Academy Trust
The Vita Multi Academy Trust Board provides governance for SHJS, with the process of establishing a Local Advisory Board underway. For more detailed information on SHJS's governance, including declarations of interests, annual reports & accounts, memorandum & articles of association, funding agreement, executive pay and facilities time reporting, please see the MAT website here.
A message from our Chair of Trustees
As the new Chair of Trustees, I am delighted to introduce myself and to share how our Board supports Sun Hill Junior School as part of the Vita Multi Academy Trust.
Our role as Trustees is to ensure that the education and wellbeing of all pupils remain at the heart of everything we do. While our responsibilities are wide-ranging – including safeguarding, health and safety, finance, premises management, and staff appointments – our central purpose is always to help create a safe, successful, and happy learning environment.
Trustees provide the strategic direction for schools within the Trust, monitoring performance, evaluating effectiveness, and holding leadership to account for the quality of education delivered. At the same time, we work closely with the Headteacher and staff team, offering support, encouragement, and recognition of the enormous dedication they bring to the children in their care.
At Sun Hill Junior School, we are fortunate to have an outstanding staff team, led with passion and commitment by Mrs Griffiths. Their daily work ensures that pupils learn and grow in a caring, creative, and safe environment, guided by the school’s “STARS” motto.
It is a privilege to serve as Chair and to play a part in shaping the future of SHJS within the Vita Multi Academy Trust. I look forward to working with our whole school community and to welcoming families into the junior stage of our Trust journey.
